description: This file defines a BroadcastReceiver class for handling Wi-Fi Direct (WiFi P2P) events, such as connection changes and device status updates, in an Android application.

classes.name: WiFiDirectBroadcastReceiver
classes.description: A BroadcastReceiver that listens for Wi-Fi P2P connection and device status change events.
